description: WRITE TOOL, not read-only. Asks VA International to start an account for a person, using their own email address. The person gets a confirmation email, then chooses their own password and accepts the terms. Until they confirm, no account, customer record or marketing consent exists. You never receive a password, login or token. The reply is the same for new and existing addresses. Only use this when the person asked you to. Accounts are for virtual assistants: other accounts are blocked at checkout.

email.description: The person's own email address. They must confirm by email.

marketingConsent.description: Only true if the person themselves said yes to product updates. Default false.

name: request_account
title: Request an account for a person
